* Hardware supply chain experience driving products from prototype to mass production.
* Experience with supply planning and accounting/finance analytics.
* Ability to collaborate and influence across multiple levels of an organization and experience leading cross functional process improvements, using strong analytical and communication/facilitation skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


As Program Manager, you will lead all aspects of supply chain readiness in New Product Introduction (NPI) products for our global data centers. You will work with cross\-functional teams starting with product inception to volume ramp to bring innovative products into global data centers efficiently and dynamically. You will demonstrate domain expertise in material readiness, clear to build, supplier and contract manufacturer management, procurement, manufacturing, supply resiliency, and are well versed in other aspects of operations and engineering that impact supply chain strategies and execution.  

  

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing materials plans, enabling prototype builds and driving production ramp plans for products deployed in our data centers. Product types include networking, infrastructure, and server and storage. You will work closely with Engineering, Supply Chain Operations, Supply and Demand Planning, Contract Manufacturing, and Supplier partners to launch new products and to implement processes and systems that directly scale new product deployments.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. jobs.title: Differential Response Program Manager
jobs.description:
**AGENCY DESCRIPTION:**

Instituto Familiar de la Raza, Inc. is a multi\-service community health \& social service agency with emphasis in serving the Chicano/Latino/Indigenous community in San Francisco with a special focus on the diverse needs of the Mission District. Services include a wide range of mental health, HIV related services, and social services including health promotion, education, prevention, early intervention, case management, clinical, psychological and psychiatric interventions as well as cultural/social and spiritual re\-enforcement. The agency serves children, youth, adults \& families; it has a rich history of working collaboratively with other agencies to meet the needs of the diverse Chicano/Latino/Indigenous communities, \& other cultural/racial communities in San Francisco.

**JOB/ PROGRAM DESCRIPTION:**

The Chicano/Latino Family Resource system (FRS) is a collaborative project of four community agencies. The project’s purpose is to combine the efforts and staff of the collaborating agencies to develop prevention, early intervention, and intensive case management programs and services which reinforce family preservation with high\-risk families residing in the Mission District and Chicano/Latino families throughout San Francisco.

The Differential Response (DR) program within FRS, works with fifteen partnered community agencies throughout San Francisco and with the Human Services Agency (HSA) to provide services to families referred to CPS and in need of additional support to prevent out of home placement and re\-referrals. This position supervises the Data and Training Specialist, as part of the Differential Response Team. Essential Job Duties are but not limited to the following:

*Program Leadership*

* Coordinate citywide Differential Response (DR) services by serving as the primary point of contact for HSA, FCS, and DEC, uplifting communication and effective service delivery
* Serve as a liaison with HSA and partner agencies by maintaining consistent communication on referrals, service outcomes, and program updates
* Support the ongoing implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of DR program procedures
* Lead implementation of the Family First Prevention Services Act (FFPSA) requirements as they relate to the DR program, ensuring compliance
* Develop and maintain annual schedules for DR\-related meetings, training, and site visits
* Support organizational and programmatic goals by participating in special projects, community events, and other related duties
* Provide leadership to DR Liaisons through consultation, coaching, and technical assistance
* Provide consultation and technical assistance to DR Liaisons and HSA staff citywide, strengthening capacity to respond effectively to family needs.
* Facilitate bi\-monthly DR Liaison meetings to foster collaboration, share resources, and promote alignment across agencies.

*Collaboration, Partnerships \& Communication*

* Lead and facilitate monthly DR Coordination Team meetings, Workgroup meetings, and Case Consultation sessions with CBO partners and HSA staff
* Collaborate with FCS Protective Service Workers, supervisors, and other representatives to determine the best fit for family needs (Red Team Meeting)
* Facilitate bi\-monthly DR Liaison meetings to foster collaboration, share resources, and promote alignment across agencies. (also relevant to capacity building)

*Referral Management \& Service Coordination*

* Triage and assign DR and SafeCare referrals received from HSA to appropriate partner agencies, ensuring timely and equitable service connection for families across the city, ensuring 95% of referrals are responded to within 2 working days

*Quality Assurance, Compliance \& Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI)*

* Conduct quarterly site visits and case chart reviews to ensure compliance with Standards of Quality for Family Strengthening and Support (SQFSS)
* Conduct quarterly quality assurance reviews of partner agencies, assessing compliance, program fidelity, and overall effectiveness of service delivery
* Develop progress reports and include outcomes in quarterly reports, framed in a CQI methodology

*Data Management, Evaluation \& Reporting*

jobs.title: Orientation and Onboarding Program Manager - HR
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Orientation and Onboarding Program Manager to lead the strategy, development, and delivery of new hire orientation experiences in our NALA region for the United States, Canada, Brazil, and Mexico. In this role, you will be the architect of a new hire's first impression of our company by creating engaging, inclusive, and informative orientation programs that connect employees to our culture, values, and mission from the start.

 **What you'll be doing:**

* Orientation Program Ownership: Design, manage, and continuously evolve a world\-class new hire orientation program, including in\-person, virtual, and hybrid formats.
* Cultural Integration: Champion our company culture and values through immersive onboarding experiences that resonate across diverse geographies and backgrounds.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with HR, Communications, IT, Legal, Real Estate and Site Services (RESS), and many other groups to curate and deliver a seamless, end\-to\-end orientation experience.
* Content Creation \& Curation: Develop and maintain engaging orientation materials including presentations, welcome videos, new hire task lists, and digital resources.
* Facilitation \& Hosting: Serve as a primary facilitator and host for orientation sessions, creating an energetic and welcoming environment for new hires.
* Speaker \& Executive Coordination: Recruit, prepare, and schedule executive speakers and cross\-functional presenters to participate in orientation programming.
* Technology \& Platforms: Manage orientation delivery platforms and tools to ensure a consistent and accessible experience for all new hires.
* Continuous Onboarding: Manage and develop continuous onboarding programs post\-orientation. This may include New Hire Office Hours, Socials, Volunteer Events and much more.
* Metrics \& Feedback: Review our Listening PM's key metrics and leverage insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Budget Management: Oversee the orientation program budget, ensuring resources are allocated effectively.
* Any other project work or job duties, as assigned.

 **What we need to see:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in HR program management, employee experience, or learning \& development, with a strong focus on orientation or onboarding programs.
* Exceptional facilitation, presentation, and public speaking skills with the ability to engage audiences of varying sizes and backgrounds.
* Strong project management and organizational skills; capable of managing multiple priorities across time zones.
* Strong business insight and understanding of cross\-functional work.
* Ability to develop strong partnering relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Working knowledge of HR law and practices.
* Customer focused while being responsive with a sense of urgency as well as the ability to lead projects to successful completion, multi\-task, and work within tight deadlines.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills: concise, articulate, confident as well as the ability to communicate and negotiate effectively with all levels of associates and management.
* Ability to work productively and collaboratively with team members and provide extraordinary customer service as well as be flexible and able to quickly adjust to new priorities.
* Ability to work onsite at the Santa Clara campus.

 **Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* SHRM\-CP, PHR, or PMP certification.
* Experience with Workday, ServiceNow, SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams.
* Familiarity with e\-learning tools such as Articulate 360\.
* Background with immigration, relocation, and HR compliance.
* Experience with global orientation and onboarding.


Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 104,000 USD \- 166,750 USD.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

**Job Req ID: 30378**
---------------------

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. San Francisco, CA; New York, NY

-------------------


Full time


**Department**
--------------


Employer Revenue


**Compensation**
----------------


* OTE $179\.2K – $224K • Offers Equity

In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including geographic location as well as candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.*


  
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.


**Why join Handshake now:**


* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

**The Role**
------------


Reporting to the Director, Account Management \- Enterprise, you'll partner with our Enterprise Client Success Management partners to ensure our employer partners see value in the Handshake product in order to retain and grow a key segment of our business.
  

  

We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Manager to join our Employer Sales Team \- working with top employers across the nation to drive their early talent recruiting strategy. You will serve as the primary owner of a set book of existing employer partners, working closely with them to ensure they achieve their goals, build relationships with executives, and drive customer retention and expansion from onboarding through renewal.


This high\-impact role combines equal parts sales, relationship management and customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate has a proven record managing relationships at scale while driving renewals and expansions in a *Saas* technology company.


* Effectively renew, upsell and cross\-sell an assigned book of business of existing premium employer partners with an emphasis on growth
* Learn your book of business inside and out to effectively position Handshake’s value proposition, always linking it back to key business issues of the customer
* Develop and cultivate deep relationships with senior executives at the Director, SVP, VP, and C\-suite levels at our partners
* Develop new and creative ways to engage senior executives throughout the customer lifecycle and demonstrate Handshake’s value
* Partner closely with our Employer Customer Success Team to ensure customers adopt and are successful on Handshake
* Manage and present data and value\-driven Quarterly Business Reviews
* Enlist and inspire customers to participate in Handshake events and other marketing materials
* Manage overall customer loyalty, serving as internal advocate and escalation point to customers
* Assist in identifying and developing scalable account management tools and methodologies that can be applied across the Account Management team
  

Help scale internal process to support hundreds of premium employers
* Becoming a Handshake expert, learning the ins and outs of HR and higher ed Tech

*Must be willing to work onsite from our SF or NY office\- expected 5 days a week.*  

*Must be willing to travel as needed for customer engagements.*


**You Have**
------------


* At least 2\+ years of sales experience in Enterprise SaaS sales or Account Management, 5\+ years in a closing and quota carrying role
* Experience preparing renewal proposals, forecasting, and account planning
* A strong history of quota attainment and excellent performance on a high\-reaching team
  

Experience with an evangelical sale, selling non\-discretionary software to executives at Fortune 1000 companies
* Experience managing customer relationships alongside a Customer Success team
* Experience using usage, data and results to demonstrate value and justify expansion
* An impeccable communicator with polished and professional sales presentation skills
* Experience operating in a high\-growth business environment like Handshake

------------


Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life.

**Ownership:** Equity in a fast\-growing company


**Financial Wellness**: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching


**Family Support:** Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching


**Wellbeing:** Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend


**Growth:** $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development


**Remote \& Office:** Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office


**Time Off:** Flexible PTO, 15 holidays \+ 2 flex days


**Connection:** Team outings \& referral bonuses


Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers.


Compensation Range: $179\.2K \- $224K

**Company Description** **Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR)** is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data\-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.


But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020\. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin\-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward\-thinking, innovative force in the market.


Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting\-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.


Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.


Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.

 **Job Description** **The Role**: As a Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Strategy, you will serve as the primary bridge between our enterprise customers and Strategy's engineering, product, and go\-to\-market teams. You will own the full post sales lifecycle of a customer account portfolio, ensuring customers do not simply "use" the platform but deeply integrate Strategy's cloud\-native architecture, Semantic Layer (Mosaic), and AI\-powered analytics capabilities into their core technology stack.


Your goal is to drive measurable business value and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by ensuring the platform is technically optimized, strategically adopted, and commercially positioned to expand.

**Location (Preferred)**: This role is ideally based in the San Francisco Bay Area, CA. Candidates located in the Bay Area are strongly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Technical Strategy \& Customer Success**

* Act as the lead technical advisor for your accounts, guiding customers through complex cloud\-native architectures, Semantic Layer (Mosaic) implementations, and AI\-driven analytics workflows.
* Leading C\-suite whiteboard sessions to align platform capabilities with high\-level business goals.
* Deep\-diving into client workflows to uncover and implement high\-value use cases.
* Translate executive requirements into value realization plans, ensuring technical migrations and data initiatives result in realized ROI and account growth.
* Develop and execute customer roadmaps that align with enterprise architecture, security requirements, and strategic business objectives — defining measurable KPIs and adoption milestones.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with both business and technical stakeholders, demonstrating ROI, reviewing progress against success metrics, and aligning on future priorities.

**2\. Technical Enablement \& Adoption**

* Lead the technical configuration and integration phase to accelerate time\-to\-value, partnering with implementation teams to ensure a smooth transition from deployment to operational use.
* Conduct deep\-dive technical demonstrations, developer "Office Hours," and capability workshops for engineering, data science, and BI teams.
* Proactively monitor account health using technical telemetry — identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, integration inefficiencies, and adoption gaps before they impact customer satisfaction.
* Monitor customer health, engagement trends, and platform adoption data to proactively identify risks and opportunities for value expansion across the account.

**3\. Product Advocacy \& Engineering Collaboration**

* Synthesize technical feedback and edge cases from the field to influence Strategy's Product and Engineering roadmaps, acting as the customer's internal advocate.
* Partner with Engineering to lead strategic customers through Alpha/Beta programs for new AI, Mosaic, and platform features.
* Serve as a high\-level technical point of contact for complex support escalations, coordinating between the customer's engineering team and Strategy's internal developers to drive timely resolution.
* Advise customers on platform enhancements, integrations, and upgrades — ensuring alignment with the Strategy product roadmap and the customer's long\-term data strategy.

**4\. Commercial Collaboration \& Customer Advocacy**

* Support the successful renewal and expansion of customer accounts by ensuring continuous technical and business value realization from the Strategy platform.
* Partner with Sales and Account Management to identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities, providing account health insights and adoption data that inform commercial strategy.
* Proactively identify renewal risks and collaborate with Sales and leadership on mitigation plans before they escalate.
* Develop strong referenceable customers willing to participate in case studies, testimonials, reference calls, and industry events.

  

**Qualifications** **Core Technical Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience) required.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-native services (microservices, Kubernetes, Docker) and major cloud pro

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

**Patient Care Coordinator** **Berkeley Hearing Center \- Berkeley, CA** **Full\-time, In\-Person**

**About Berkeley Hearing Center**

Berkeley Hearing Center has been the audiologist\-led home for premium hearing healthcare in the East Bay for more than seven decades. We don't dispense hearing aids. We build long\-term clinical relationships, guided by our Berkeley Hearing Method (Understand, Build, Adapt, Protect), and powered by a team that genuinely believes care should never be compromised.

This is a practice built on depth, not volume. Our patients are educated, discerning, and often navigating one of the more significant health decisions of their lives. They deserve a front\-line experience that honors that.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Patient Care Coordinator to join a well\-staffed, well\-supported front\-office team. This is a full clinical\-support role, not a reception position. You will be the first voice a new patient hears, the last person they interact with after an appointment, and a consistent presence in a care relationship that may span years.

While it may feel like a routine appointment to our schedule, it is a significant moment for the person walking through the door. Your job is to make sure they feel that difference every single time.

**Who You Are**

Experience matters. But character matters more. If your friends and coworkers would describe you like this, we want to meet you:

* Always warm, positive, and genuinely enjoyable to be around
* Friendly and approachable from the very first hello, including over the phone
* Patient, calm, and compassionate, especially with older adults
* A team player who pitches in without being asked and puts the team before ego
* Detailled and acurate: you double\-check your work and rarely make mistakes
* Takes ownership: gives credit, takes initiative and responsibility, and solves problems
* Comfortable multi\-tasking and confident under pressure
* Coachable and open to feedback, always looking to improve
* Reliable and consistent: here, on time, and prepared

That's not just who we're looking for. It's also who you'll be working alongside.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Answer inbound calls and schedule appointments with empathy and clinical awareness, guiding patients through a process that can feel unfamiliar or daunting
* Manage provider schedules to balance new\-patient access with continuity of care for returning patients
* Prepare audiologists for appointments with complete, accurate notes and relevant patient history
* Welcome patients in a way that reflects the quality of care they are about to receive
* Coordinate hearing technology orders, repairs, and manufacturer communications
* Handle patient check\-out, payment collection, and financial policy communication with clarity and confidence

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong interpersonal skills, particularly with older adults and their families
* Detail\-oriented with a genuine understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality
* Technologically confident: VoIP phones, online scheduling, digital fax queues, and a willingness to learn new systems
* A clear, confident communicator in writing and in person
* Someone who helps patients understand the value of treatment through honest, educational conversation
* Spanish fluency is a meaningful advantage in our patient community
* Healthcare or audiology front\-office experience is a plus, but we hire for the person first

**What You Get**

* $25\-28/hour base pay
* Health and dental coverage after 60 days
* Team\-based bonus opportunities tied to practice performance
* Profit\-sharing 401(k) after one year
* Real growth potential as the practice expands
* A team that is genuinely glad you're here

**How to Apply**

Send us your resume and a brief note explaining why this role is the right fit for you.

One more thing: this posting contains exactly two spelling errors. Point them out. It tells us something important about how you work.

We look forward to meeting you.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $25\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

jobs.title: Care Advocate
jobs.description:
Seven Starling is a leading virtual provider of women's behavioral health services supporting every stage of motherhood. Seven Starling's holistic clinical model combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat common perinatal mood disorders like postpartum depression and anxiety, with 94% of patients seeing a clinically significant improvement in their symptoms after completing the program. Seven Starling partners with OBGYN clinics across the country and leading health plans including UnitedHealthCare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna to make care easily accessible and affordable.



### **Position Overview**


Seven Starling is looking to add a world\-class Care Advocate to join our Care Support team. Our ideal candidate is an experienced support professional who is passionate about improving women’s mental health outcomes, and is energized by the opportunity to ensure our patients receive compassionate and effective mental health care and our clinicians treating them receive world class support. You will excel in this role if you have a strong attention to detail, love staying organized, enjoy learning new systems and tools, have experience in high\-volume settings, and are skilled at developing and implementing scalable processes that help our operations run efficiently.

### **What you’ll do**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for patients and providers, addressing their questions, concerns, and needs in a professional and empathetic manner.
* Assist with scheduling and rescheduling patient appointments to maximize patient engagement and success, including managing conflicts and optimizing appointment schedules.
* Maintain accurate patient records and documentation, ensuring data is up\-to\-date and compliant with privacy regulations.
* Assist in the resolution of patient or provider issues or complaints, escalating more complex concerns to the appropriate team members or supervisors.
* Serve as the “voice of the patient”, keeping a close eye on data and trends from your support work and surfacing learnings to the appropriate team members or supervisors.
* Provide support to patients and providers navigating the healthcare system, including explaining procedures, insurance processes, and available resources.
* Coordinate care activities, including follow\-up appointments, outside referrals, and coordination with other healthcare providers as needed.
* Collaborate with healthcare professionals and administrative staff to ensure seamless patient care and communication.
* Participate in ongoing training and development to stay current with best practices and organizational changes.
* Propose updates to key processes as needed to maintain them.

### **Who you are**

* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience in a patient support, customer service, or healthcare\-related role.
* Experience in a remote work environment.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, especially in a high\-volume setting. Strong attention to detail.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact effectively with patients, families, and healthcare professionals.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.
* Proficiency in using standard office applications (e.g., Google Suite).
* Demonstrated problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to patient support.
* High school diploma or equivalent; additional coursework in healthcare administration or a related field is a plus.

### **Perks and Benefits**

* Competitive paid time off
* Competitive parental leave and return to work policy
* One\-time stipend to enhance your work from home experience
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K
* Annual stipend for your choice of wellness benefits
* Annual professional development stipend
* Virtual team events

* This position is eligible for over\-time
* Meaningful equity package with significant upside potential

jobs.title: Patient Access & Eligibility Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist**


 Overview:


The Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist plays a critical role in supporting patient access to care management services by ensuring accurate insurance verification, confirming program eligibility, and assisting patients through administrative intake processes.


This role serves as the front door to the care management program, helping identify eligible patients for Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and other virtual care services.


The Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist verifies insurance coverage, confirms patient eligibility, answers incoming patient calls, manages voicemail communications, and ensures accurate documentation within electronic medical record (EMR) systems and care management platforms.


The ideal candidate has strong technical proficiency, excellent communication skills, and the ability to navigate multiple healthcare systems efficiently while delivering a professional and compassionate patient experience.


Reports To: Nursing Manager


Department: Clinical Operations

**Job Description**:

**Patient Call Management \& Communication**

* Answer incoming patient calls and provide professional, courteous assistance.
* Respond to patient inquiries related to care management programs and services.
* Manage voicemail systems by reviewing incoming messages and ensuring calls are routed to the appropriate team member or department.
* Coordinate call routing to Care Coordinators, Enrollment Specialists, or other staff based on patient needs.
* Ensure patient messages are handled promptly and accurately to support timely follow\-up.
* Document all patient communications within the care management platform.
* Maintain strict adherence to HIPAA and patient privacy standards during all interactions.

**Insurance Verification \& Eligibility Determination**

* Verify patient insurance coverage and eligibility for care management programs.
* Confirm payer requirements for Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and other services.
* Review patient benefits, coverage status, and eligibility criteria.
* Identify patients who qualify for enrollment in care management programs.
* Document eligibility verification results in the appropriate systems.

**Enrollment Pipeline Support**

* Prepare eligible patient lists for the Enrollment team by verifying eligibility and insurance coverage.
* Flag patients who meet program criteria for outreach and enrollment.
* Support enrollment readiness by ensuring patient demographic and insurance data is accurate.
* Communicate eligibility findings with Enrollment Specialists to support effective patient outreach.
* Assist with administrative preparation for patient enrollment processes.

**Administrative \& Platform Support**

* Maintain accurate patient demographic and insurance information within care management platform.
* Assist with patient record updates and administrative workflows related to care management services.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, complete and compliant with program requirements.
* Support internal teams with patient information verification and administrative tasks.

**Technology \& Data Accuracy**

* Utilize electronic medical records (EMR), care management platforms, and telephony systems to support patient access workflows.
* Demonstrate strong technical proficiency when navigating multiple healthcare platforms simultaneously.
* Maintain a high level of accuracy when entering patient information into healthcare systems.
* Assist with resolving minor data discrepancies and escalate system issues when necessary.

**Qualifications and Skills Required:**

* 1–3 years of experience in healthcare administration, patient access, insurance verification, or care coordination support
* Experience verifying health insurance eligibility and benefits
* Familiarity with Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), or population health programs preferred
* Experience working with electronic medical record (EMR) systems
* Strong technical proficiency and ability to learn new healthcare platforms quickly
* Experience handling patient phone calls in a professional healthcare environment
* Excellent verbal communication and patient engagement skills
* Strong organizational and time management abilities
* High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

**Competencies:**


Competency

  

Definition

  

Patient Communication

  

Provides clear, compassionate communication when assisting patients.

  

Insurance Verification

  

Demonstrates strong understanding of insurance coverage and eligibility processes.

  

Technical Acumen

  

Navigates EMR systems and healthcare technology platforms efficiently.

  

Attention to Detail.

  

Ensures accuracy in documentation and patient data entry.

  

Compliance Awareness

  

Maintains HIPAA compliance and proper handling of protected health information.

  

Organization

  

Manages multiple tasks and systems effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

  

Collaboration

  

Works closely with Enrollment Specialists, Care Coordinators, and operations staff.

  


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Insurance verification accuracy rate
* Eligibility verification turnaround time
* Patient call response quality and timeliness
* Voicemail response and routing accuracy.

**Work Location, Shift \& Schedule**  

  

This position is remote (please see remote requirements below). Shifox/Alopex employees work Monday\-Friday r according to the business hours of client practices.  

  

**Remote Position Requirements:**  

Reliable and stable Internet – all programs used by **Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist** are internet based. A quiet and professional work environment suitable for speaking with patients about sensitive information and Protected Health Information (PHI), free of distractions.  

  

**Compensation**:

jobs.title: Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations (Mandarin, Fully Remote)
jobs.description:
We are hiring a **Mandarin\-speaking Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations** who combines strong U.S. immigration case\-management experience with advanced AI and legal\-technology skills.

This is not a traditional paralegal position.

We are building an AI\-native immigration practice where highly capable case managers use AI and modern case\-management technology to independently manage substantially more of the case lifecycle—from intake and evidence collection through drafting, quality control, and attorney\-ready review.

You do **not** need to be an AI engineer or programmer.

You **do need to be highly fluent with AI and modern business software and already know how to use Claude effectively for sophisticated immigration work.**

We are specifically looking for someone who understands how to use Claude beyond basic prompting—for example, working with large case files and long\-context documents, structuring complex immigration analysis, extracting and organizing evidence, identifying inconsistencies and missing information, developing evidence matrices, preparing and improving drafts, analyzing RFEs, performing quality control, and building repeatable AI\-assisted workflows.

You should know how to give AI the right context and instructions, evaluate its output critically, verify it against source documents, identify hallucinations or unsupported conclusions, and iterate until the work product meets a professional standard.

**AI proficiency is a core qualification for this position, not something we expect to teach from the beginning.**

**What You’ll Do**

You will take ownership of immigration cases from assignment through attorney review, including:

* Communicating directly with clients in Mandarin and English
* Reviewing intake information, CVs, immigration records, and supporting documents
* Identifying missing information and proactively following up
* Managing case progress, deadlines, and outstanding items
* Preparing immigration forms and supporting documentation
* Organizing evidence and exhibits
* Assisting with petitions, recommendation letters, RFEs, and other case materials
* Using Claude extensively for document analysis, evidence analysis, drafting, case organization, and quality control
* Using modern case\-management and business software efficiently
* Checking AI\-generated work against the underlying record
* Identifying factual inconsistencies and potential issues
* Escalating matters requiring attorney judgment
* Developing better prompts, templates, checklists, and repeatable workflows
* Delivering organized, substantially complete cases for attorney review

The objective is straightforward:

**Once a case is assigned to you, you should be capable of moving it from intake to attorney\-ready review with minimal attorney intervention.**

**Who We’re Looking For**

You may be a strong fit if you have:

* Professional fluency in **Mandarin Chinese and English**
* Meaningful U.S. immigration case\-management or paralegal experience
* **Advanced proficiency using Claude for professional immigration work**
* Strong general AI literacy and the ability to work effectively with large amounts of information
* High proficiency with modern corporate software, document\-management systems, cloud collaboration tools, and case\-management platforms
* Experience independently managing immigration cases
* Excellent organization and attention to factual detail
* Strong written communication skills
* The ability to manage multiple matters without constant attorney supervision
* The judgment to distinguish routine production issues from matters requiring attorney attention

Experience with employment\-based immigration—including **EB\-1A, EB\-2 NIW, O\-1, H\-1B, L\-1, PERM, I\-140, and I\-485**—is highly valued.

Experience at a sophisticated business immigration practice is a plus, but not required.

**What “AI Proficiency” Means to Us**

We are **not** looking for someone whose AI experience consists primarily of asking ChatGPT or Claude to rewrite emails.

A strong candidate should be comfortable demonstrating how they use Claude to work through an actual immigration matter.

For example, you should be able to take a substantial client file and use AI intelligently to:

* understand and structure the case;
* extract relevant facts from multiple documents;
* identify missing or contradictory information;
* create timelines;
* analyze and categorize evidence;
* build evidence matrices;
* analyze publications and citation records;
* organize EB\-1A/O\-1 evidence by criterion;
* organize NIW evidence around the proposed endeavor;
* analyze an RFE against the existing record;
* prepare customized evidence requests;
* produce first drafts from verified source materials;
* compare drafts against underlying evidence;
* perform consistency and quality\-control reviews;
* and turn successful approaches into reusable workflows.

You should also understand AI’s limitations.

**Fast AI\-generated work that contains unsupported facts, missed evidence, or hallucinations is not good work.**

The person we want knows how to make AI powerful **and** reliable.

**Why This Role Is Different**

Most immigration case\-management positions are still structured around traditional production methods.

This one is not.

We want to see what happens when an experienced immigration professional becomes exceptionally effective at combining:

**Immigration knowledge \+ case ownership \+ Claude \+ modern software \+ operational judgment.**

The objective is not simply to draft faster. It is to enable one excellent case manager to perform work that traditionally required substantially more administrative and junior\-production support.

**Career Growth**

This position has a significant growth path for someone who performs exceptionally well:

**Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations**  
→ **Senior Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations**  
→ **AI Operations / Case Management Lead**  
→ **Manager o

jobs.description:
**Accounting Operations Manager — QuickBooks Online**

Sunistics Group \| Fully remote, U.S.\-based \| $32–$40 per hour

Flexible weekday scheduling, with availability beginning no later than 7 a.m. Pacific / 10 a.m. Eastern. Weekly hours and working schedule will be agreed before hiring.

**Own the accounting operation**

Sunistics Group delivers commercial solar projects. We need a hands\-on Accounting Operations Manager who takes responsibility for accurate books, reliable payment processing and consistent follow\-through. You will organise the work, resolve issues and keep management informed without needing reminders.

You will work with our existing accounting team and external accountant. This role combines ownership of the accounting workflow with doing the work in QuickBooks Online: reconciling accounts, reviewing records, coordinating approvals and processing payments.

**What you will own**

* Keep QuickBooks Online current each week. Review bank and credit\-card activity, match transactions correctly, maintain project classifications and resolve missing or duplicate entries.
* Own the month\-end checklist and agreed close deadlines. Reconcile bank and credit\-card accounts, investigate differences and provide complete supporting records to our accountant.
* Organise vendor invoices, statements and payment requests. Confirm documentation and approval, schedule and process authorised payments, and follow through on discrepancies.
* Manage crew reimbursement requests from receipt through approval and payment. Check receipts, amounts and project details, resolve missing information and ensure each payment is recorded once.
* Manage shared accounting inboxes and scanned incoming mail. Route requests, assign follow\-up and track deadlines so important items do not get lost.
* Coordinate priorities and review work across the accounting workflow. Maintain clear procedures, identify bottlenecks and escalate issues with a concise explanation and recommended next step.
* Keep cash\-planning inputs reliable, including expected payment dates and unresolved items, while reducing duplicate entry between QuickBooks and company spreadsheets.

**AI proficiency is required**

Using artificial intelligence to improve efficiency is an expectation of this role. You must already be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini or comparable tools for practical work—not simply interested in learning them later.

* Use company\-approved AI tools to simplify document handling, organise information, analyse spreadsheets, draft communications and document repeatable processes.
* Propose and implement useful improvements, checking whether they save time and improve accuracy.
* Verify AI output against original documents and accounting records. Protect confidential information and follow company rules for approved tools and data use. You remain responsible for accuracy; AI does not replace payment authorisation or accounting judgment.

We will ask for a brief example of an AI\-assisted workflow you have used and how you checked its results. Coding or building AI software is not required.

**What you bring**

* At least five years of relevant bookkeeping or accounting experience, including at least two years independently owning a recurring accounting cycle.
* Strong recent QuickBooks Online experience, including bank and credit\-card reconciliation, accounts payable, correcting errors and month\-end work.
* Evidence of taking ownership: setting priorities, resolving problems, coordinating others and meeting deadlines without repeated reminders.
* Practical AI experience, sound spreadsheet skills and confidence learning new systems.
* Clear written communication and good judgment when handling payments, vendor details and confidential records.
* U.S. residence and the ability to meet the stated weekday availability requirement.

Construction, trades or project\-based accounting experience is strongly preferred. QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification is helpful. Demonstrated capability matters more than a particular degree or previous job title.

**What success looks like**

During your first 90 days, you will establish a dependable weekly accounting routine, own an agreed month\-end close schedule, make outstanding issues visible, and document the core payment and reimbursement workflows. You will also implement an agreed AI\-assisted improvement and demonstrate that its output is reliable.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and brief answers to our screening questions. Specific examples of work you personally owned are more useful than broad descriptions of your strengths. Shortlisted applicants will have a focused interview and professional reference checks. No take\-home exercise is required.

Pay: $65,539\.45 \- $83,148\.59 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Describe a business whose accounting cycle you personally owned. What did you do in QuickBooks Online, roughly how many accounts or transactions did you handle, and how did you know month\-end was complete? Include how you tracked unfinished work or reviewed work completed by others. Please use 3–5 sentences.
* A $1,250 vendor bill is already in QuickBooks. Its approved credit\-card payment appears in the credit\-card feed. A colleague has also entered a separate $1,250 expense for the same purchase. What would you check, and how would you resolve it? Please use 2–4 sentences.
* A vendor payment deadline is today, but new bank details arrived by email. A crew reimbursement request is also urgent and has no receipts or project information. What would you do first, what would you hold, and what would you tell management? Please use 2–4 sentences.
* Name an AI tool you have actually used for accounting or administrative work. Describe one specific task, what it improved, and how you checked the result and handled confidential information. Please use 3–5 sentences. Do not i

jobs.title: Global Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  

  

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.


The Global Business Operations Manager is aligned to an assigned zone comprising multiple countries and serves as the primary business liaison between global Commercial Excellence and zone and country organizations. The role ensures coordinated adoption, governance, and execution of CRM\-related processes, sales operating standards, data governance requirements, and commercial initiatives across the zone.  

The GBOM partners with zone leaders and country\-level roles to translate global standards into coordinated zone priorities and practical country execution, while ensuring common needs, local requirements, risks, and adoption barriers are represented in governance forums and transformation programs.  

The role steers execution across the assigned zone by aligning country plans, consolidating priorities and performance insights, reinforcing clear ownership and consistent operating routines, and coordinating cross\-country action and escalation to achieve zone and country business goals.**Key Responsibilities**

**Zone Operating Model \& Country Execution**

* Translate global CRM business standards into a coordinated zone operating model and clear country\-level execution expectations, including required fields, process steps, ownership rules, and reporting routines.
* Establish and maintain a zone governance cadence with zone and country stakeholders to review adoption, data quality, pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, priorities, dependencies, and open risks across assigned countries.
* Align country execution plans to zone priorities and global standards while documenting approved local deviations, rationale, owners, effective dates, and required approvals.
* Coordinate with zone leadership, country CRM support, Sales Operations, and Commercial Excellence teams to clarify handoffs, decision rights, accountability, and shared actions required to achieve zone and country goals.

**Zone Governance \& Country Representation**

* Serve as the primary Commercial Excellence representative for an assigned zone and its constituent countries.
* Act as the key point of contact connecting global CRM and governance organizations with zone leaders and designated country\-level roles.
* Coordinate communication and deployment of global commercial policies, governance standards, and process changes across the zone, supporting consistent execution in each country.
* Consolidate country feedback, adoption barriers, business risks, and local requirements into a zone perspective for representation in global governance forums.
* Maintain visibility to zone objectives and country priorities, readiness, performance, decision needs, and implementation dependencies; coordinate action plans and escalations with the appropriate zone and country owners.

**CRM \& Process Adoption**

* Drive adoption of standardized sales processes and CRM practices.
* Monitor adherence to opportunity management, customer engagement, forecasting, and funnel management standards.
* Partner with zone commercial leadership and country sales leaders to address adoption gaps, process compliance issues, and shared performance goals.

**CRM Data Quality \& Pipeline Discipline**

* Monitor completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency of key CRM data fields across the assigned zone and its countries.
* Partner with zone and country teams to resolve duplicate records, inactive or expired funnel, missing ownership, territory mismatches, and other CRM data quality issues.
* Reinforce standards for account ownership, territory alignment, opportunity stage progression, close\-date maintenance, forecasting inputs, and customer engagement documentation.
* Coordinate zone and country action plans to improve pipeline hygiene and enable reliable business reviews, forecasting, and commercial performance reporting.

* Generous paid time off and paid holidays, because we value recharging.
* A comprehensive health benefits plan with a portion of premiums covered by the company. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, and other benefits which are optional to the empl

jobs.description:
**Posting Title:** Assistant Project Manager \- O\&M
**Reports To:** Senior O\&M Specialist**Location:** Hybrid or Remote**Salary Range:** $82,000 to $106,000
* ***This position is eligible for the annual performance bonus plan.***

This position primarily involves working remotely or in an office.

Final determination of a successful candidate’s starting pay will vary based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, education and experience. The pay scale listed for this position is generally for candidates that meet the specified qualifications and requirements listed on this specific job description. We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.**WHO WE ARE**  

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high\-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.
**THE ENERGY TEAM**
Our Energy Group at CEI builds projects from the field to the grid. Whether it’s a solar, battery storage, substation, EV charging, microgrid or converter station project, our skilled project managers, engineers and field employees deliver when it matters most. We work with customers on programs of all sizes—those spanning several smaller sites or spanning several thousand acres. Besides building some of the nation’s largest utility\-scale solar plants and installing more EV charging stations in California than any other contractor, we are dedicated to running a business that is environmentally responsible.
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
At Cupertino Electric, **Assistant Project Managers (APM)** are key to coordination between the field team, project team, and our customers. By partnering with the Project Manager, the APM will learn the processes and witness the critical thinking required for approaching our projects from a strategic lens. The APM will gain a deep understanding of CEI’s scope of work on a project. Additionally, they contribute to, review, and track project activities including change orders, submittals, tracking logs, and related project documents.
* Lead team meetings and provide guidance to Project Engineers and Project Coordinators in partnership with the Project Manager, Production Manager, field team and Trade Partners.
* Identifies cost and schedule impacts associated with RFIs, submittals, and design changes and provides timely notification.
* Prices change orders consistently and in a timely manner for project manager review and approval.
* Develops and manages close out documents as the Project progresses.
* Coordinate commissioning activities w/ 3rd party. Tracks and follows up on open items.
* Maintain strong working partnerships with vendors and subcontractors. Coordinates accurate material releases on time and consistent with project documents. Track material releases, changes and coordinate delivery with construction schedule.

**ABOUT YOU*** Serve as the go\-to person to help resolve any issues or potential problem areas.
* Actively thinks about new ways to improve or change processes. Brings innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to a project.
* Prior experience working on semi\-remote jobsites, supervising others. Renewables/Large Electrical/Data Center build experience highly desired.
* Good working knowledge of MS applications including Excel.
* Prior experience in electrical estimating and the ability to accurately estimate change order pricing.
* Knowledge of Electrical Code and Civil Construction.

**WHAT YOU WILL GAIN**
As an Assistant Project Manager (APM) at Cupertino Electric, you will be empowered to learn the skills and competencies required to become a successful Project Manager. APMs have the opportunity to execute Project Manager level activities within the safety of the larger Project Team. This is when all of the deep, technical, and process\-guided learning comes into play. Partnered with a Project Manager, through practice and feedback, you will learn the processes, and witness the critical thinking required for strategic project approach, which will in turn set you up for a successful future on your career path. You will be interacting extensively with the CEI Production Team, customers, and vendor and subcontractor partners, giving you opportunities to cultivate relationships and build your professional network.
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS***Any combination of education and experience that, in the sole judgment and discretion of Company, would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications may qualify.***Education:** High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s Degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or similar preferred.
**Licensure/Certifications:** None required.
**Experience:** Three (3\) or more years of experience specifically as a Project Engineer in electrical construction (Renewable Energy preferred) or MEP/Civil/Structural experience in general contracting. Minimum five (5\)\+ years of related experience, including some time managing smaller projects.
**Driving Record:** Valid state\-issued driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.
* Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist, Heavy Duty Automotive**  

**Location:** Remote (U.S.\-based) Preference given to CA, TX, and FL  

**Department:** Customer Success  

**Reports to:** Chief Customer Officer  

**Starting Pay Range: $90k \- $105k/yr**  

  

The Arcadium platform is the premier sales, CRM and vehicle management solution in the heavy\-duty truck market. As part of Work Truck Solutions, Arcadium has a culture that combines strong leadership, collaboration, and fun, with incredible growth opportunities for our employees in a fast\-paced work environment providing employee engagement, recognition, and development. Our software company is committed to innovation in the rapidly changing heavy\-duty vehicle market.  

Our vision and culture allow employees to be recognized as thought leaders and thrive in their careers.  

  

In addition to the job responsibilities and requirements, the following are essential to be a successful member of our team:  

**Curiosity**: you seek knowledge, ask questions, and look for answers; you’re proactive and  

engaged  

**Perseverance**: you hit a delay; you know this is your moment to figure things out and to shine **Innovation**: you want to make things better, solve the puzzle, create something new  

**Flexibility**: there’s a new opportunity; you’re ready to flip the script, grow and adapt  

  

This role owns the successful launch of Arcadium for **newly signed heavy\-duty truck, trailer, equipment, and bus franchise dealers**, as well as the rollout of new functionality for existing customers. Arcadium’s primary product is a market\-specific customer relationship management (CRM) platform built for how heavy\-duty franchise dealers operate. The **Implementation Specialist** is responsible for **on\-time implementation, customer satisfaction, and platform utilization** for each assigned implementation \- assessing each dealership’s needs, configuring the platform to meet them, and training dealership teams on best\-practice use so they see value from day one.  

  

This role sits at the intersection of the customer, the product, and the internal teams that deliver it. The Implementation Specialist coordinates the contributions of Support, Development, Product, Sales, and Account Management to keep every implementation on track, and continuously looks for ways to improve the quality and efficiency of the implementation process, including recommending process and product changes. This is an individual contributor role reporting to Customer Success leadership; it requires strong project management, consultative, and training abilities, and up to 25% travel for on\-site dealer implementations and training.  

**Key** **Responsibilities**
============================

* + **Needs Assessment \& Discovery:** Lead structured needs assessments with dealer principals, general managers, and department leaders to document current workflows, lead and customer management processes, data, integrations, and goals across the dealership’s new and used sales, parts, and service departments.
* + **System Configuration:** Translate assessment findings into a configuration plan and set up the Arcadium platform \- users, roles and permissions, rooftops and departments, workflows, lead sources, templates, data imports, and integrations \- to fit each dealership’s operations and Arcadium best practices.
	+ **Implementation Project Management:** Own each implementation from kickoff through go\-live, building and maintaining the project plan, milestones, and timeline; managing risks and dependencies; and keeping customer stakeholders and internal teams informed of status.
	+ **Training \& Best\-Practice Adoption:** Deliver role\-based training, remotely and on site, to dealership users and leadership, focused on best\-practice use of the platform so teams adopt it quickly and consistently.
	+ **New Functionality for Existing Customers:** Plan and implement new products, features, and expanded use \- such as additional rooftops, departments, or modules \- for existing customers, partnering with Account Managers and Sales to drive adoption and utilization.
	+ **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Coordinate the activities of Support, Development, Product, Sales, and Account Management that contribute to each implementation \- scoping requests, tracking deliverables, escalating blockers, and ensuring a clean handoff to Account Management after go\-live.
	+ **Process \& Product Improvement:** Identify recurring issues, bottlenecks, and gaps in the implementation process and recommend process, tooling, and product changes that improve quality, shorten time\-to\-value, and increase efficiency.
	+ **Field Engagement:** Travel up to 25% to conduct on\-site activities at dealer locations, and participate in company\-sponsored and industry events such as dealer association meetings and trade shows.
	+ **Documentation \& Reporting:** Maintain accurate, real\-time implementation status, configuration records, training completion, and customer feedback within the company CRM system, and contribute to implementation playbooks, templates, and training materials.
	+ **Market Expertise:** Develop deep expertise in the Arcadium platform and our full portfolio of solutions and share information and context internally \- including customer feedback regarding dealership operations and customer needs.

jobs.title: Multilingual Collections Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
About ¡WEPA! líbros®

¡WEPA! líbros® partners with schools and public libraries to expand access to authentic books in the languages their communities speak. We design curated collections around each client’s educational goals and source books internationally to bring those collections to life.

About the Role

You will own assigned collection projects from the approved client brief through the handoff to purchasing. You’ll direct and review curation, resolve gaps, track deadlines, and make sure each collection is accurate and ready to order.

We’re looking for someone with strong judgment about multilingual literature who is equally strong at moving work forward. In this remote role, you’ll keep project records current, make decisions within your scope, and communicate early when a deadline or requirement is at risk.

What You’ll Do

* Turn client goals, age levels, languages, budget, and collection priorities into clear direction for curators.
* Assign and review curation work, checking both individual titles and the balance of the collection as a whole.
* Catch and resolve issues involving age fit, genre, language, cultural relevance, ISBNs, formats, duplication, inventory, and availability.
* Curate titles directly when a project requires it.
* Maintain clear project synopses, status updates, and outstanding decisions.
* Coordinate changes and substitutions with purchasing.
* Deliver complete purchasing handoffs on time, with unresolved issues identified and addressed.
* Communicate directly with clients about collection direction and approvals when assigned.

What You’ll Bring

* Experience in collection development, children’s literature, school or public libraries, curriculum materials, publishing, or a related field.
* A track record of managing detailed projects and meeting deadlines without close supervision.
* The ability to review a collection against a brief and make specific, defensible corrections.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and close attention to book data.
* Clear written communication and good judgment about when to act, collaborate, or escalate.
* Reliable availability and follow\-through in a remote role.

Spanish proficiency is helpful. Experience working with multilingual collections is welcome, but the ability to manage collection quality and project execution is essential.

This is a part\-time W\-2 position with scheduled weekly availability.

Job Type: Contract

Pay: $22\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* A collection is due to purchasing on Friday. On Wednesday, you discover that several books do not meet the client’s grade\-level requirements, and the curator’s list is incomplete. You have other projects due that week. In 150 words or fewer, tell us what you would do before the end of Wednesday, what you would communicate, and how you would protect the Friday handoff.

Work Location: Remote

**About the Role**: Pluribus Digital is seeking a **Deputy Program Manager (DPM)** to join our team supporting a high\-impact federal contract with the Department of the Treasury. This role is ideal for someone with strong program management experience who thrives in fast\-paced, agile environments and wants to help modernize mission\-critical systems that directly serve the public.

As DPM, you will play a vital role in overseeing day\-to\-day operations across multiple Agile delivery teams. You'll serve as a key liaison between client stakeholders and cross\-functional teams, supporting the Program Manager in strategic execution, delivery quality, and team performance. You'll help guide operational processes, remove blockers, align staffing needs, and ensure delivery excellence while fostering a culture of trust, accountability, and continuous improvement.


**What You'll Do**
#### **Organizational \& Program Leadership**


* Manage daily operations for assigned program areas across multiple teams.
* Translate strategic goals from the Program Manager and government stakeholders into actionable team\-level plans.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies; escalate issues when needed.
* Coach and support technical and team leads; foster a collaborative, high\-performance culture.
* Track program health metrics including burn rate, contract deliverables, and team capacity.
* Approve timecards and PTO requests; support performance feedback and expectation setting.

#### **Agile Delivery \& Execution**


* Help shape overall delivery strategy and ensure alignment across teams.
* Support Agile teams in defining scope, sprint priorities, and delivery objectives.
* Provide administrative and operational coverage for Scrum Masters, Team Leads, and Program Manager as needed.
* Serve as a resource for team\-wide agile best practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and help remove blockers.

#### **Stakeholder Engagement \& Reporting**


* Facilitate information flow between the program manager, government stakeholders, leadership, and Pluribus teams.
* Communicate status, risks, and issues clearly and proactively to internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare program summaries and performance reports; support compliance with contract terms, timelines, and deliverables.

#### **Staffing \& Team Development**


* Collaborate with recruiters and delivery leadership to forecast, plan, and fulfill staffing needs.
* Support interviews, onboarding, and performance management for new hires.
* Help stand up new teams and identify team leads or mentors as needed.
* Address performance or behavioral concerns in collaboration with leadership.

#### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Partner with Capability Leads, PMO team, and Technical SMEs to align tools, standards, and direction.
* Contribute to continuous improvement efforts and help evolve internal program frameworks.
* Provide mentorship, hands\-on support, and leadership continuity across teams as needed.

**What you will bring:**
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Clearance.
* PMP certification.
* 5\+ years experience in program or project management within large\-scale federal contracts.
* Proven experience leading Agile software delivery, DevOps, or data\-focused teams.
* Experience supporting cross\-functional teams with matrixed reporting structures.
* Strong communication, relationship\-building, and leadership skills.
* Knowledge of federal budget and procurement processes.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience in a technical role (e.g., software engineering, DevOps, systems, or data).
* Agile certifications (Scrum Master, Product Owner, SAFe).
* Experience working in blended sprint and Kanban delivery models.
* Experience supporting Government contracts.
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and results\-driven.
* Strong facilitation and conflict\-resolution skills.
**Why Pluribus May Be a Fit for You:**



We are purpose driven. We support missions and products that serve the public good, and where our focused capabilities positively impact those mission outcomes. We bring a consultative approach to partner with our government customers and help them succeed as change makers.



Pluribus is a calm company. We are knowledge workers. People do their best work when they are not rushed by artificial urgency or drained by a culture of facetime and workaholism. By having confidence in our people, we can get more done at better quality. When real crunch time comes, we are not already stretched to the limit.



We are stronger because of the variety of skills and personal backgrounds of our team. We hold ourselves accountable and we publish our workforce statistics annually.


***Compensation and benefits****:*


*Pluribus Digital offers a competitive salary that is determined at the time of offer. Compensation will be based on experience and qualifications, with salary ranges aligned accordingly. If a candidate is a strong fit at a more junior or senior level to what is outlined here, we will assess them accordingly and apply the appropriate salary range during the hiring process. The range for this specific role is from $150,000 to $170,000 depending on experience. Salary is augmented with opportunity to earn annual bonus and medical/dental/vision benefits, PTO, company paid life insurance and a generous 401k match program. jobs.description:
**Cybersecurity Project Manager**

* Do you have a keen eye for detail and excellent analytical skills?

The Greentree Group is a dynamic, innovative, and thriving company that specializes in delivering advanced technology solutions to federal, state, and commercial clients. With a team of highly skilled professionals, we provide cutting\-edge services and are always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
What sets us apart is our commitment to excellence and our passion for the work we do.
