We offer a dynamic and supportive work environment, a culture of continuous learning, and a wide range of benefits and perks that promote work\-life balance and personal well\-being.
Whether you're a seasoned expert or just starting out in your career, if you're passionate about technology, committed to excellence, and eager to take on new challenges, we want to hear from you!

The Greentree Group values its employees and fosters a collaborative environment where talented professionals can thrive. We are seeking an experienced **Cybersecurity Project Manager** to lead a complex cybersecurity assessment program supporting a public sector client in Austin, TX.
This role will be responsible for planning, managing, and overseeing cybersecurity assessment activities conducted in accordance with CMS security and privacy requirements, including the Acceptable Risk Controls for ACA, Medicaid, and Partner Entities (ARC\-AMPE) framework and applicable NIST standards. The successful candidate will lead assessment teams, manage project schedules and deliverables, coordinate stakeholder communications, and ensure the successful execution of security assessment and authorization activities.
The ideal candidate is a proactive leader who can effectively manage technical teams, communicate with executive stakeholders, translate complex cybersecurity concepts into actionable recommendations, and drive projects to successful completion while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.

As a Cybersecurity Project Manager, you will play a key role in helping clients understand, assess, and mitigate these risks through structured assessment, compliance, and risk management activities.
**Key responsibilities include:**
* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of cybersecurity assessment projects, ensuring adherence to contractual requirements, schedules, budgets, and quality standards.

* Identify project risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints, and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Present technical findings, compliance gaps, and risk\-based recommendations to both technical and executive audiences.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to enhance assessment methodologies, project execution processes, and client outcomes.
* Ensure project teams maintain compliance with established cybersecurity, privacy, and quality assurance requirements.
* The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to the client, helping leadership understand cybersecurity risks, prioritize remediation efforts, and make informed decisions regarding the protection of critical systems and sensitive data.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, executive leadership, technical teams, and third\-party stakeholders.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity industry standards, frameworks, and best practices.
* 5\+ years of experience supporting Security Control Assessments (SCAs), security authorizations, or related cybersecurity compliance activities.
* Experience conducting or overseeing technical security audits and assessments for large, complex systems.
* Experience presenting security control requirements, assessment results, risks, and deficiencies to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* 5\+ years of project management experience leading cybersecurity, compliance, or assessment engagements.
* Experience developing and managing project schedules, budgets, staffing plans, and client deliverables.
* Experience identifying, tracking, and mitigating project and cybersecurity risks.

From photographing rocket launches and recoveries, to producing engaging videos, to information technology management, to using social media to share NASA’s message, eMITS integrates services for NASA IT and provides NASA’s communication to the outside world. Come join us in support of NASA’s mission to inspire the world through information and discovery.


**Job Description:**


This role will support the NASA Office of the Chief Human Capital Office (OCHCO) in the implementation of the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Federal HR 2\.0 initiative by managing meetings, organizing working groups, coordinating OPM data call responses, maintaining communication with OPM and NASA stakeholders, and keeping leadership informed through streamlined tracking, reporting, and documentation. jobs.title: Palliative Care Social Work Case Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role***


This specific role provides Social Work support to our Palliative Care Program.


Devoted’s virtual Palliative Care program serves members with complex needs and life\-limiting illness who otherwise would not have access to specialized palliative care. We pride ourselves on providing highly compassionate, patient\-centered goals of care counseling and symptom management for members projected to be in the final year of life. We meet patients where they are and support them in defining quality of life, achieving meaningful goals, and transitioning to hospice care.


As a Palliative Care Social Work Case Manager, you will serve our patients as an advocate, coach, and connector \- working closely with patients, caregivers and other members of the team to identify and eliminate socioeconomic and psychosocial barriers and provide supportive counseling. This role will require you to develop individualized care plans that align community, clinical, and patients’ personal resources.You will provide coaching on improving coping skills, self\-management, and caregiver assistance, re\-enforce disease\-specific education and facilitate goals of care and advanced care planning discussions, including hospice care transitions when appropriate.


Responsibilities will include:

* Telephonic and video visits with patients and caregivers
* Establish trust and build strong relationships with our patients
* Interdisciplinary collaboration with teammates (including clinicians, nurses, and care coordinators) to ensure cohesive, patient\-centered care for high\-needs patients
* Conduct Social Work interventions to maximize the effectiveness of the program


	+ Conduct psychosocial assessments and create personalized care plans tailored to members’ needs
	+ Provide emotional and caregiver support
	+ Assist in navigating complex family/support issues
	+ Complete goals of care conversations and advanced care planning
	+ Conduct long term care planning and placements
	+ Place/follow through on behavioral health referrals
	+ Investigate concerns for patient abuse or neglect
* Know how to balance multiple competing priorities from complex patients
* Work with family members/caregivers to help them in understanding the member’s needs and how they can be supportive
* Manage or lead conversations with patients, caregivers, and family regarding goals of care, and social drivers of advanced care planning
* Facilitate and participate in family meetings and joint visits
* Participate in team huddles, panel reviews, interdisciplinary team rounds, and program/role growth and development
* Build relationships and coordinate with key local market and internal stakeholders
* Document all clinical interactions in the electronic health record

***Attributes to success***

* Ability to walk alongside those with terminal illness and to gentle the sacred transition from life to death
* You meet patients and families where they are, hold them with compassion, and are able to release yourself from the outcome
* You love helping others improve their health and navigate a complex healthcare system with compassion, empathy, and warmth
* You’re a caring problem solver who can break down barriers
* You connect with people quickly
* You follow up relentlessly
* A deep caring to make a change in the healthcare experience: you love to serve and make a difference
* The ability to adjust your tone and approach to different people
* You can articulate and break down complex information
* Being present, reliable and timely \- for our members, for your team
* The ability to work in a startup environment: which means moving quickly and being transparent in your work, what’s going well, what’s not
* You enjoy a fast\-paced, high\-energy, organization; Agility and collaboration are key as we will change and improve quickly
* You are comfortable engaging and learning new technologies including electronic health records, operating systems and programs (Google Office, Slack). You thrive on knowing your work can help make these technologies better for you and your patients.
* You learn from every experience and are not afraid to fail \- that's how you're wired
* Finally and most importantly, you have a passion for making healthcare better for patients at end\-of\-life, solving complex problems, and supporting the delivery of healthcare that we would want for our own family members

***Desired skills and experience***


Must Haves

jobs.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.


As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. -----------------------



With direction from the QA Inspection Supervisor(s) and Quality Management perform dimensional inspections on machined and molded components manufactured from internal and external sources per engineering drawings and applicable external standards. Maintains inspection equipment including Vertex and Vectors. Also maintains control of products on hold.

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------



Perform first article and final product inspections working from engineering drawings, procedures, and external standards, using typical inspection equipment such as micrometers, thread gauges, calipers, optical comparator, concentricity gauge, and height \& depth gages.


Perform receiving inspection of Finished Goods and components using typical inspection equipment.


Perform component testing utilizing various inspection equipment such as tensile testers, force gages and custom equipment.


Complete and maintain all QA paperwork in accordance with established procedures and manufacturing practices including the generation of receiving and inspection records, first article reports, discrepant material reports, QA history log sheets, and document change requests (DCR’s) as required. Ensure all handwritten documentation is clear and legible.


Support the qualification/validation of new products/process projects; perform specialized inspections to help engineering develop new products, gages, and inspection methods.


Follow written procedures and engineering specifications utilized for inspection and ensure documents are kept current and adequate for the inspections performed. Provide feedback to QA Management on documents requiring updates or error correction.

Publish various daily quality related reports.


Perform additional duties as assigned by supervisor.

**What Makes You Stand Out**

Ability to use typical measuring devices (micrometer, caliper, comparator, thread gages, go/nogo gages and custom gages) and test instruments (pull and torque testers).


Experience in medical device manufacturing and / or clean room is a plus.


Working knowledge of sampling techniques (e.g., ANSI Z1\.4\.), Good Manufacturing Practices and other regulatory standards required.


Ability to read standard operating procedures engineering drawings; Ability to lift boxes less than 50 lbs


Attention to detail

**Job Title: Workforce Management Analyst (Remote)**


**Location:** Remote \- United States


**Employment Type:** FT Hourly


**Compensation:** $30 per hour



**CareTalk Health**



CareTalk Health is a virtual\-only national medical practice delivering chronic care management and preventive care to Medicare members through health plan partnerships. The Clinical Operations Manager for Virtual Care Management owns the operations that carry a patient forward after the visit — care navigation, longitudinal chronic care management, and remote therapeutic monitoring.


**About the Role**



We're a virtual telehealth practice looking for a Workforce Management (WFM) Analyst to own forecasting, capacity planning, and analytics across our virtual clinic. You'll support scheduling and staffing for all key roles — Patient Support Specialists (PSS), RNs, and Providers.



This is a hands\-on analytical role, not a traditional WFM seat. You will build and refine forecasts working alongside AI tools we've developed in\-house. We're looking for someone genuinely curious about applying large language models (LLMs) and AI to forecasting and planning problems — comfort and curiosity here matter more than years on any one platform.



**Schedule**



This is a full\-time role working Monday – Friday 9am – 6pm ET. Some flexibility is needed based on clinic hours, which may include occasional evenings and Saturdays.


**Key Responsibilities**


**What You'll Do**



Forecast contact and demand volume and build capacity/staffing plans across teams * \- forecasting and analytics will be roughly 75% of the role.
* Monitor queues and staffing in real time, tracking adherence and service levels throughout the day and making intraday adjustments to keep coverage on target.
* Flag and respond to intraday risks — volume spikes, absences, and shifting demand — and communicate recommended adjustments to operations.
* Pull and combine source data from multiple inputs and analyze it to produce actionable staffing recommendations.
* Use our AI\-powered tools — and your own prompting and experimentation with LLMs — to generate, test, and validate forecasts against historical performance.
* Build and maintain reporting on key WFM metrics: occupancy, adherence, service levels, and staffing accuracy.
* Account for clinician licensing constraints (including multi\-state licensure) when planning clinician coverage, so the right licensed staff are available for the right patients.
* Collaborate with operational leadership to flag risks and recommend adjustments.


**Required**



* **Minimum of 2 years of experience as a workforce management** analyst or in a WFM operational role.
* **Contact center experience is required.**
* Hands\-on experience with real\-time queue monitoring and adherence in a contact center setting.
* Strong Excel skills, with the ability to work with data from multiple sources and turn it into clear forecasts and recommendations.
* AI fluency — comfort and curiosity using LLMs and AI tools in day\-to\-day analytical work.
* Clear communicator who can translate data into recommendations for non\-technical stakeholders.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Zoom Contact Center CX Analytics.
* Familiarity with clinician licensing and multi\-state licensure rules.


**Work Location Requirement**



This is a remote U.S.\-based position. Employees must perform all work physically within the United States. International work is not permitted during scheduled work hours.


**Work Environment**



This is a remote position and may be "on camera" at any time. You will work from a home office, requiring reliable internet connectivity and a secure, private workspace.



**Technical Requirements:**


* **Computer:**
	+ Windows or Apple (macOS) Computer ONLY (NO Chromebooks, Linux Machines, or Smartphones)
	+ **Must** have at least Windows 10 or macOS 14 Sonoma.
* **Hardware:**
	+ Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Equivalent (Windows); Apple Silicon (Macs)
	+ RAM: 16 GB
* **Headphones:** Wired headphones required for optimal audio quality. (NO built\-in mics)
* **Internet Speed:** Meet minimum internet speed requirements (100 MBPS download speed and 50 MBPS upload speed). Must have an ethernet cable connecting computer directly into router.
* **Browser and System:** Use Google Chrome with Amazon Workspaces (regardless of computer type).
* **Webcam:** A webcam is required for video calls. Most laptops have a built\-in webcam, which is acceptable. If your computer does not have a webcam, you will need to use an external webcam.
* **Recommended Equipment:** A second monitor is highly suggested for laptop users; dual monitors for PC users.

The notice explains the categories of personal information we collect, how we use and retain it, whether we sell or share it, and your privacy rights under California law:* *https://caretalkhealth.com/california\-privacy\-notice**.*

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.


Role Overview
  

The Program Manager, Compliance is a strategic driver of Stord’s operational strength and commercial growth. This role is responsible for scaling enterprise compliance programs across OSHA, EPA, GMP, and adjacent regulatory regimes \- building the infrastructure that enables Stord to operate with confidence, win in the market, and deliver on the compliance commitments that today’s leading brands require from a fulfillment partner. A mature, well\-run compliance program is not just a risk management function at Stord; it is a competitive differentiator that unlocks customer revenue, supports network expansion, and protects the business at scale.
  

  

Reporting to the Director of Health, Safety \& Security, this is an enterprise\-level, network\-wide role that operates at the intersection of compliance, operations, and growth. The Program Manager partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and Finance to ensure compliance capabilities are a strength Stord leads with \- enabling the business to pursue regulated customer segments, scale into new markets, and demonstrate the program maturity that top\-tier brands demand. The work product of this role is what the entire organization is built around: scalable written programs, audit frameworks, certification standards, reporting infrastructure, and regulatory intelligence systems that grow stronger as Stord grows.
**What This Role Owns**
=======================

This role owns the enterprise compliance program architecture \- the standards, written programs, audit frameworks, and governance mechanisms that define what ‘compliant’ looks like at every Stord facility. The work product of this role is what the rest of the organization is held accountable to. Specifically:


* Enterprise compliance program design, construction, and ownership across OSHA, EPA, GMP, GDP, DOT, and applicable state and local regulatory frameworks \- building programs from the ground up where gaps exist and elevating inconsistent standards to enterprise\-grade.

* Enterprise compliance reporting, data, and dashboards: building the metrics infrastructure that gives the Head of HSS, senior leadership, and the broader business real\-time visibility into compliance performance, risk posture, and program health across the network.
* Enterprise compliance training architecture: defining what training is required, for whom, at what frequency, and in what format \- building the content and governance framework that regional and site teams deliver against.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and own Stord’s enterprise OSHA compliance program \- designing the written program architecture, establishing network\-wide standards, and creating the governance mechanisms that ensure consistent compliance across every facility regardless of size, volume, or operational complexity.
* Maintain and update OSHA\-required written programs: Hazard Communication, Lockout/Tagout, Respiratory Protection, Emergency Action Plans, Powered Industrial Truck programs, and others as applicable.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**



Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI\-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.


**About the Role**



We are looking for a results\-oriented Customer Success Manager to drive client outcomes and revenue growth across our publisher (Supply) partners.



In this role, you will own a portfolio of accounts end\-to\-end, responsible for renewals, expansion, and long\-term partner value. You will act as a strategic advisor to your clients, aligning Zeta’s solutions to their business goals while ensuring strong platform adoption and measurable performance.



You will operate with clear accountability to revenue targets, pipeline development, and account health, while maintaining a high bar for client experience. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking, operational discipline, and proactive client engagement.


**What** **You’ll** **Do**


**Own Revenue \& Account Growth**


* Own a book of business with accountability for renewals, upsell, and cross\-sell within existing publisher accounts
* Build and manage a pipeline of expansion opportunities; maintain visibility into account growth and pacing to goals
* Monitor account performance against forecasts and identify risks and opportunities early


**Drive Strategic Client Engagement**


* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned accounts
* Lead client communications including business reviews (QBRs/ABRs/SBRs), performance updates, and strategic planning sessions
* Develop a deep understanding of partner KPIs, monetization strategies, and success metrics


**Deliver Performance \& Insights**


* Analyze campaign and platform performance to provide proactive, data\-driven recommendations
* Identify optimization opportunities and drive execution in partnership with internal teams
* Translate data into clear, actionable insights that align with client goals


**Lead Account Operations \& Execution**


* Own account planning, reporting, and overall account health tracking
* Maintain strong Salesforce hygiene including opportunity tracking, forecasting inputs, and activity documentation
* Lead platform demos, onboarding, and training sessions to drive adoption and value realization


**Collaborate Cross\-Functionally**


* Partner with Sales, Supply Operations, Product, and Support teams to deliver consistent client outcomes
* Support RFP responses and strategic opportunities in partnership with Sales
* Surface client feedback and insights to inform product and operational improvements


Requirements


* 4–7\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Publisher Partnerships (Supply Side)
* Demonstrated ability to drive renewals and grow revenue within existing accounts
* Strong client\-facing presence with the ability to influence both day\-to\-day and executive stakeholders
* Experience managing multiple accounts with competing priorities and deadlines
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to translate performance into strategic recommendations
* Strong operational discipline, including experience with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and pipeline tracking
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**Preferred:**


* Experience in digital media, ad tech, or publisher ecosystems
* Understanding of Ad Serving, CRM data/audiences, Ad Tags, and Email Service Providers (ESP)
* Basic understanding of HTML and campaign setup processes


**BENEFITS \& PERKS**


* Unlimited PTO
* Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Employee Equity
* Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!


**SALARY RANGE**



The salary range for this role is **$110,000 \- $120,000\.00****,** depending on location and experience.


**PEOPLE \& CULTURE AT ZETA**



Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.


We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a\-look\-into\-zetas\-ergs/


**ZETA IN THE NEWS!**



https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat\=press\-releases



\#LI\-EK!

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager- Services California
jobs.description:
**Why** **You’ll** **Love Working Here**



At SimuTech Group, we are driving innovation and changing the world through the power of engineering simulation. Our growing team of energetic, tech\-savvy professionals works hard every day to inspire our clients to push the boundaries of innovation and deliver transformational products. If you are motivated and driven by a culture where top\-notch work ethic and passion are rewarded, then a career with SimuTech Group may be for you!



**The Benefits of Being Part of Our Team**



* Unmatched Health Coverage: Zero\-cost in\-network medical care with no premiums, deductibles, or copays for you and your family.


* Complete Dental \& Vision Benefits: 100% premium coverage for dental and vision insurance.


* Wellness Programs Tailored to You: Access free workouts, personalized training sessions, nutritional counseling, mindfulness programs, stress management, and more with our corporate wellness coach.
  


**What Makes This Role Great?**



* You’ll thrive in a competitive and results\-driven environment where your leadership, sales expertise, and ability to build relationships are celebrated.


* You’ll have the opportunity to drive revenue growth by connecting with decision\-makers and delivering impactful solutions to meet client needs.


* You’ll join a dynamic sales team that values ambition, creativity, and a passion for achieving goals.
  


**What** **You’ll** **Do**



As a Services Territory Account Manager, you will sell SimuTech consulting services directly to end users via phone, virtual, and face\-to\-face contact. You’ll manage both transactional and complex sales while collaborating closely with a dynamic team of highly skilled engineers who provide technical expertise throughout the sales cycle.



Lead Business Development



* Identify and connect with potential clients, leveraging persuasive communication skills to introduce SimuTech’s consulting solutions.


* Challenge clients by proposing innovative tools and engineering processes, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor.


* Collaborate with inside sales, marketing, and engineering teams to develop customized solutions for client challenges.


Drive Sales Growth

Execute structured, milestone\-driven sales strategies to meet or exceed ambitious revenue goals.



* Manage consultative sales processes, engaging with decision\-makers at all levels to uncover needs and deliver tailored solutions.


* Negotiate and structure consulting deals to drive Ansys software sales and deliver measurable client value.


Build Strong Relationships



* Develop and nurture long\-term partnerships with clients, ensuring ongoing satisfaction and success.


* Organize and lead impactful customer\-facing events, such as workshops, user groups, and industry seminars.


* Represent SimuTech Group at industry events, positioning yourself as an industry expert and thought leader.
  


**What** **You’ll** **Bring**



Education \& Experience



* Bachelor’s degree or a minimum of 5 years of industry experience.


* Previous technical sales or engineering experience.


**Skills**



* Confidence and Independence: You’re a self\-starter who takes initiative and thrives in situations where you can think on your feet.


* Persuasive Communication: You excel at delivering compelling messages and can adapt your style to different audiences.


* Analytical Thinking: You dig deeper to uncover customer needs, crafting solutions that resonate with their challenges.


* Resilience: You handle rejection effectively, maintaining a positive outlook and determination to succeed.


* Technical Expertise: A solid understanding of engineering processes and related technologies (CAD, 3D printing, HPC).


* Time Management: You prioritize effectively and stay organized, even in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment.
  


**Additional Benefits**



* Short Term Disability


* Long Term Disability


* 401k Plan with employer match


* Limited Flexible Spending Account


* Life Insurance


* Paid time off


* Professional development assistance


* Referral program


* Tuition reimbursement


* Bonus plan


**Pay range:** Base \- $85,000 \- $100,000 OTE $170,000 \- $200,000 USD  

*(Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on* *a number of* *factors, including a candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and location.)*



Location: Remote\-based in California

  


**Take the Next Step**



This is your opportunity to join a forward\-thinking team where your skills, creativity, and ambition will be celebrated. Apply today to become a key player in SimuTech Group’s mission to revolutionize the engineering industry.



SimuTech Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Workforce Management Professional
jobs.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================


The Senior Workforce Management Professional applies and integrates advanced and predictive analysis, people metrics and reporting to develop strategic and operational insights for workforce decision\-making (e.g., staffing, learning and development, talent management, diversity and human resource compliance). The Senior Workforce Management Professional work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors.
The Senior Workforce Management Professional is an integral member of Humana’s Workforce Management team, supporting the Grievance and Appeals Medical Directors. This role blends advanced strategic analysis with operational workforce management, focusing on both enterprise\-level planning and day\-to\-day execution to ensure optimal staff deployment and service delivery. This role requires an individual who is willing to roll up their sleeves and own operational workforce management activities today while helping shape the future state of workforce management for the organization. Success in this role requires equal comfort with detailed execution, process improvement, data analysis, and strategic workforce planning.


This role is ideal for an individual who enjoys building and improving workforce management processes. Initially, the position will focus on operational workforce management activities including scheduling, case assignment, reporting, and workforce administration. As workforce processes and reporting capabilities become more automated, the role will increasingly focus on workforce planning, operational analysis, and strategic decision support for leadership. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in an environment where processes continue to evolve and mature. They possess the curiosity and initiative to challenge existing approaches, identify inefficiencies, and develop scalable solutions that improve operational effectiveness. They are equally comfortable managing detailed day\-to\-day workforce activities as they are analyzing trends, developing recommendations, and influencing workforce strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

* Perform short\-range and intermediate forecasting for staffing needs, incorporating real\-time data, utilization trends, and anticipated demand fluctuations.
* Manage daily case assignment and inventory distribution while continually evaluating workload trends, skill alignment, process effectiveness, and opportunities to improve workforce performance.
* Creates reporting that is applicable and useful to Physician Leadership and Medical Directors, such as productivity and handle times.
* Translate workforce data into meaningful insights and recommendations for physician leadership, balancing day\-to\-day operational requirements with long\-term workforce planning and optimization strategies.
* Administer and conduct tactical capabilities such as scheduling and absence management, ensuring accuracy and compliance with established policies, as well identify efficiencies as they arise.
* Assess organizational staffing, identify requirements, and recommend solutions to meet both immediate and future workforce objectives.
* Provide actionable analysis of talent and staffing needs, supporting strategic and operational goals at the department and segment level.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of organizational strategy, departmental objectives, and their linkages to related business areas to inform workforce decisions.
* Collaborate with leadership and cross\-functional teams to support operational execution and strategic initiatives, leveraging strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Make independent decisions regarding work methods and approaches, including resolving issues in ambiguous or evolving circumstances with minimal supervision.
* Ensure all workforce management activities comply with U.S. federal and Puerto Rico employment laws and Humana’s internal guidelines.
* Monitor and report on key workforce metrics; adjust planning and processes as needed to optimize performance and employee engagement.
* Identify opportunities to automate, streamline, and optimize workforce management processes, reporting, and operational workflows, reducing administrative effort and enabling more strategic workforce planning activities.
* Assess newly developed and existing workforce processes and recommend/take action on improvements that enhance efficiency, scalability, reporting accuracy, and the overall experience of leaders and team members.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* 6\+ years of Workforce Management experience, including forecasting, inventory management, and tactical planning
* Advanced experience with Verint Workforce Management
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to use data to drive business decisions
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience sharing insights with senior leaders
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail
* Experience supporting complex healthcare operations, physician groups, or other highly skilled professional clinical teams.
* Proven ability to develop workforce management processes, improve operations, and make strategic recommendations
* Comfortable working in evolving environments and adapting to changing business needs
* Passion for improving customer and member experiences
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where processes, workflows, and requirements may evolve over time.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in healthcare utilization management, grievance and appeals, or other regulated health

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Remote \| Part\-Time or Full\-Time**

We are hiring a highly analytical **Revenue Operations Analyst** for a fast\-growing education company generating **$10M\+ annually**.

Your role is to give leadership clear, reliable insight into the revenue engine by owning dashboards, scorecards, funnel reporting, data accuracy and performance analysis.

You will help track the full funnel:

**Paid Ads → Leads → Setters → Bookings / HOT Transfers → Sales Conversations → Sales → Upsells → Cash Collected**

What You’ll Do

* Build and maintain revenue dashboards and scorecards
* Track targets, actuals, variance and trends
* Analyze funnel conversion rates
* Identify bottlenecks, anomalies and revenue leakage
* Report performance by channel, department and team member
* Investigate why revenue or conversion rates change
* Reconcile data across CRM, payment and marketing systems
* Improve data accuracy and standardize KPI definitions
* Automate recurring reporting where possible
* Prepare weekly revenue insights for leadership

Key Metrics

You may work with:

* Ad spend, CPL, CAC and ROAS
* Leads, bookings and show rate
* HOT transfer performance
* Close rate and offer rate
* Revenue per call
* Cash collected
* Sales by closer
* Backend / upsell revenue
* Revenue by campaign and source
* Team member performance

What We’re Looking For

You should be strong in:

* RevOps, Sales Ops or Revenue Analytics
* Google Sheets and/or Excel
* Advanced formulas and pivot tables
* Dashboard creation
* Funnel analysis
* Data cleaning and reconciliation
* KPI reporting
* Root\-cause analysis

Experience with tools such as **GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Zapier, Make, Meta Ads or payment processors** is highly valuable.

You do not need experience with every tool. We care most about your ability to turn messy data into **clear, accurate insights leadership can act on**.

Ideal Candidate

You are:

* Highly analytical
* Detail\-oriented
* Commercially minded
* Proactive
* Comfortable questioning numbers
* Strong at identifying inconsistencies
* Able to explain data simply to senior management

Schedule

**Part\-Time:** approximately 20 hours per week  
**Full\-Time:** approximately 35–40 hours per week

Fully remote.

How to Apply

Please include:

* Your RevOps / analytics experience
* Tools you are strongest with
* Your availability
* Whether you prefer part\-time or full\-time
* Your expected hourly rate or compensation

Pay: $32\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Revenue dropped 20% month over month. Walk us through exactly how you would diagnose the cause, from the top of the funnel to cash collected. What would you check first, what comparisons would you make, and how would you identify the biggest revenue leak?
* You discover that the CRM says $420,000 in sales, the payment processor shows $365,000 collected, and the sales dashboard reports $448,000\. How would you determine which number is correct and fix the reporting so leadership can trust it going forward?
* Tell us about a dashboard, scorecard, or revenue reporting system you personally built or owned. What KPIs did you track, what tools did you use, and give one example of an insight you found that led to a business decision or revenue improvement.

Experience:

* Revenue Operations Analyst: 4 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

**Product Analyst / Business Analyst (Home Care Domain Expert)**


**Position Overview**



 We are looking for a Home based care industry veteran to join our team as a Product Owner/ Business Analyst. In this role, you will bridge the gap between real\-world caregiving and software development. We are building the next generation of software for home\-based care agencies, and we need your hands\-on expertise to ensure our tools work seamlessly for the people who use them every day.



You will use your first\-hand knowledge of agency workflows to define product features, write requirements for our development team, and serve as our internal subject matter expert (SME). Prior experience working in home health, personal care, or care coordination is strictly required. Software development or formal project management experience is a nice\-to\-have.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Translate Field Experience into Features:** Use your knowledge of home care operations to define, document, and prioritize user\-friendly software features and requirements for our engineering team.
* **Manage the Product Backlog:** Maintain and organize the list of software enhancements, updates, and defect fixes for the development team.
* **Bridge Communication:** Work closely with software developers to ensure they understand the daily realities of home health workers, resulting in practical, efficient applications.
* **Create Support Materials:** Write clear, accessible User Guides and Implementation Guides to help agencies adopt our software.
* **Support the Sales Team:** Act as the product Subject Matter Expert (SME) during pre\- and post\-sales activities to help potential clients understand the value of our solution.
* **Process Improvement:** Collaborate with active business users to understand their current workflows, suggest improvements, and design new software features that solve their pain points.
* **Project Coordination:** Oversee the development lifecycle and provide basic project coordination from initial feature design through post\-production rollout.

**Qualifications**


* **Required****:** Minimum of 2\-3 years of professional experience within a Home Health, Personal Care, or Home\-Based Care Agency.
* **Required:** First\-hand experience in roles such as Home Health Aide (HHA), Care Coordinator, Scheduler, Billing Specialist, or multi\-department agency operations.
* **Required:** Deep, practical understanding of home health business processes, caregiver workflows, and industry challenges.
* **Preferred****:** Prior experience using Home Health Software/EMR platforms (e.g., AlayaCare, HHAeXchange, Homecare Homebase, KanTime).
* **Nice\-to\-Have:** Previous exposure to software development environments, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Business Analysis, or Project Management.
* **Education****:** Bachelor's degree in a healthcare, business, or related field is preferred, but equivalent hands\-on agency management experience is highly valued.


 **Pay**


* Based on experience. Beginning at $60,000 annually and increases with skill\-level and proven work history

**A bit about us**  

We’re Hyve \- organizer of the world’s fastest\-growing and most forward\-thinking B2B events. As the chosen event partner to many of the world’s leading companies, our platforms play a critical role in their strategies \- helping them enter new markets, accelerate growth and connect with the people who matter most.

jobs.description:
WorldClinic, Inc. is redefining healthcare, delivering physician\-led, immediate\-access care that achieves exceptional clinical outcomes and strong financial returns.

  

Through our two platforms, we serve both ends of the workforce: **WorldClinic** provides 24/7 connected healthcare to globally mobile executives and business leaders, resolving the majority of medical issues in a single call. **JobSiteCare** has redefined occupational health for employers with frontline and at\-risk workforces through a combination of telemedicine and on\-site medics, delivering end\-to\-end case management from injury through return\-to\-work – resulting in significant reductions in OSHA recordables and workers’ compensation claim costs.

  

Together, we deliver clinical excellence and measurable outcomes at scale, for any patient population, anywhere.

  

Just as deeply as we care for the patients we serve, we invest in our own team. You'll find a mission\-driven culture that values contribution, encourages growth, and empowers employees to do meaningful work.

  

Offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check (and for Health and Wellness Specialist positions a pre\-employment drug screen). WorldClinic, Inc (and its affiliates) is a drug\-free workplace and complies with all applicable federal and state laws regarding testing. Refusal to submit to a test or failure to meet the requirements of the background check will result in the withdrawal of the employment offer.

 **Business Analyst**

**Location:** Remote (United States) – *Must be available during Eastern Time core hours*

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Exempt

**Department:** Product Management

**About Us:**  

Join WorldClinic and JobSiteCare, physician\-led companies redefining healthcare delivery through immediate\-access care and occupational health innovation. We are a mission\-driven culture that values contribution, encourages growth, and empowers employees to do meaningful work. We're looking for a proactive Business Analyst to sit at the center of our product and technology work, translating how our business operates into clear requirements our development teams can build against.

**About the Role:**

* Serve as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating clinical, operational, and commercial needs into technical realities.
* Elicit and document clear business requirements through stakeholder interviews, workflow observation, and collaborative working sessions.
* Map current\-state and future\-state processes, identifying gaps, redundancies, and clear automation opportunities.
* Write unambiguous user stories with testable acceptance criteria, partnering with QA and engineering to eliminate guesswork before development begins.
* Maintain and groom the product backlog alongside product managers by writing, refining, and prioritizing work items.
* Support data migration and system integration efforts, including field mapping, data validation rules, reconciliation, and cutover readiness.
* Facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT) by building test scenarios, coordinating business testers, and tracking defect resolution to closure.
* Produce and maintain critical supporting documentation, including process maps, data dictionaries, release notes, and end\-user training materials.
* Contribute actively to sprint ceremonies (planning, standup, review, retrospective) to keep delivery status visible and honest.

**Ideal Candidates:**

* **Experienced:** 3\+ years as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or in a comparable requirements\-focused role.
* **Agile\-Savvy:** Demonstrated experience writing user stories and managing backlogs using tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* **Analytical:** Strong process mapping skills with fluency in diagramming tools like Lucidchart, Visio, or similar.
* **Communicator:** Exceptional written and verbal skills, with the ability to produce documentation that a busy executive and a software developer will both find highly useful.
* **Organized:** Proven ability to manage competing priorities across multiple concurrent workstreams without dropping threads.
* **Collaborative:** A track record of working effectively in a distributed team with proactive communication and comfort driving alignment over video and text.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in healthcare, digital health, EHR/EMR systems, or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2\).
* Experience supporting a platform migration, major system implementation, or API\-based integrations.
* Exposure to behavior\-driven development (BDD) and Gherkin\-style (Given/When/Then) acceptance criteria.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent practical experience.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary seated or standing position for up to 8 hours daily while working on a computer.
* Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other digital office equipment to draft requirements and map workflows.
* Must be able to frequently communicate, present, and exchange accurate information over video conferencing platforms and in writing with distributed team members.
* Must be able to have close visual acuity to perform activities such as analyzing data, viewing a computer terminal, and extensive reading or documentation review.

**Perks \& Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* HSA \& FSA
* 401(k) \+ match
* Paid time off \& tuition reimbursement
* Professional development opportunities
* Flexible remote work schedule
  

**The pay range for this role is:**  

85,000 \- 110,000 USD per year(Remote)

jobs.title: Learning and Development Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Net at Work**

  

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid\-size businesses. Our award\-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next\-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.  

  

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry\-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

 **About this Position**


As Net at Work continues to evolve its internal systems, processes, and technology platforms, we are seeking a Systems Learning Specialist to support employee readiness, technology adoption, and learning enablement across the organization.

  

The Systems Learning Specialist plays a key role in helping employees successfully adopt and utilize business systems, tools, and processes. This role partners closely with Learning \& Development, Systems Operations, and business stakeholders to transform system requirements, workflows, and process updates into engaging and effective learning experiences.

  

This position is focused on the execution of training initiatives, including content development, facilitation, documentation, and user adoption support across multiple technology platforms.

 **Job Responsibilities**

* Develop and deliver instructor\-led, virtual, and self\-paced training programs for employees.
* Create engaging learning materials including presentations, job aids, quick reference guides, videos, process documentation, and knowledge articles.
* Support employee adoption of business systems including ticketing platforms, HR systems, collaboration tools, and operational applications.
* Translate system updates, process changes, and business requirements into clear learning content.
* Conduct platform walkthroughs, testing, and hands\-on exploration to understand workflows and user experiences before developing training materials.
* Facilitate new system launches, enhancements, and adoption initiatives.
* Assist with AI enablement efforts by developing and delivering foundational AI learning content and best practices.
* Maintain and update training materials to ensure content remains accurate and current.
* Partner with subject matter experts to gather information and validate training effectiveness.
* Support employee onboarding and ongoing learning initiatives related to business systems and technology tools.
* Track participation, feedback, and adoption metrics to continuously improve learning programs.

 **Job Requirements**

* 2\-5 years of experience in corporate training, learning and development, employee enablement, instructional design, or systems training.
* Experience creating training content and learning materials.
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills.
* Ability to quickly learn new software platforms and business processes.
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
* Strong organizational and project coordination abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications including PowerPoint, Teams, Excel, Word, and SharePoint.
* Experience supporting software implementations or system rollouts.
* Experience with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, HRIS platforms, or workflow applications.
* Familiarity with learning management systems and digital learning tools.
* Experience creating video\-based learning content or microlearning assets.
* Exposure to AI tools and AI\-assisted content development.

 **Customer Requirements**


This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

 **Core Competencies**

* **Client Champion** – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
* **Problem Solver** – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge\-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
* **Promise Keeper** – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
* **Collaborative Integrator** –Team player, unifier, relationship\-oriented, win\-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
* **Driven Intrapreneur** – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self\-confidence, and a can\-do attitude.
* **Inspiring Coach** – Help employees, clients and partners using knowledge, expertise, experience, and situational fluency.

 **Compensation and Benefits**


Base salary range: $85,000 to $95,000\.


This position is also eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan.

  

Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or product\-specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws.

  

We provide competitive, affordable, and diverse benefit programs that support your total health – from healthy body to healthy mind. These benefits support you and your family in all aspects of life:

* Health and Welfare (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Life and AD\&D Insurance
* Short\- and Long\-Term Disability Insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Transportation and Parking Accounts
* Health Savings Accounts (with company contribution)
* Retirement Planning (401k with matching contribution)
* Legal Benefits
* Identity Theft Protection
* Pet Insurance

jobs.title: Claims Support Supervisor - Auto Insurance
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW:**  

  

Founded in 1989, United Automobile Insurance Company is an innovative and established organization looking for a Claims Support Supervisor to join our team. Family\-owned, UAIC, is one of the largest privately held property and casualty insurance companies in the United States. The key to our growth and success is a commitment to providing quality service to our agents and customers, by providing disciplined underwriting, and strategic claims handling. Our ongoing efforts to invest substantial resources in personnel and technology are the foundation of our promise of assuring maximum efficiency and specialized operations in the industry. We are proud that our independent agents and customers have recognized our dedication by making UAIC the market leader in every state where we conduct business.  

  

***This postion offers remote work in the South East Region***  

  

**SCOPE**  

  

The Claims Support Supervisor leads licensed adjusters who provide elevated claim service, explain coverage and liability information, process first\-party claim payments, and make decisions that move insured losses toward closure. The supervisor provides operational direction, quality oversight, coaching, and escalation support while ensuring work remains within team authority. Matters requiring upper\-level investigation, complex coverage determinations, negotiation, or settlement with claimants are referred to the appropriate adjusting staff.  

  

**KEY DUTIES*** Lead, coach, and support a team of licensed fast track adjusters serving as elevated points of contact for policyholders and claimants.
* Oversee accurate processing of first payments to insureds, shops, and related parties, as well as reissuance of payments previously issued on a claim.
* Review, Approve, and guide team explanations of coverage, policy terms, claim status, liability, and next steps to ensure accuracy, consistency, and appropriate licensed\-level service.
* Review and approve payments, and letters to parties to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Handle supervisor escalation calls and activities as needed.
* Review and approve fault ratings and coverage resolutions as needed.
* Provide oversight of coverage and liability reviews on insured losses and ensure decisions are supported by claim data, properly documented, and within assigned authority.
* Handle escalated questions and disputes beyond adjuster authority; determine when a matter requires management involvement or referral to an upper\-level adjuster.
* Audit calls, claim notes, payment activity, and decision quality for compliance with company policy, Florida DFS regulations, and documentation standards.
* Monitor productivity, quality, attendance, customer service, payment accuracy, and claim\-resolution metrics; communicate expectations and manage performance concerns.
* Conduct regular one\-on\-ones, coaching, training, and development activities; ensure licenses remain active and required training is completed on time.
* Manage daily staffing, workload, call coverage, and priorities so the team responds effectively to customer needs and moves eligible claims toward closure.
* Serve as a licensed resource for the team and entry\-level CSRs; identify trends, process gaps, and training needs and recommend operational improvements.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**  

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate degree preferred.
* Active Florida 6\-20 All\-Lines Adjuster license in good standing is required.
* Prior P\&C insurance service or claims experience is required; UAIC experience and previous leadership or coaching experience are preferred.
* Strong communication, organization, analysis, coaching, and conflict\-resolution skills with sound independent judgment.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred; proficiency with claim systems, contact\-center tools, reporting, and Microsoft Office applications.

  

**BENEFITS:*** 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with employer match.
* Comprehensive Medical, Prescription Drug, Vision, and Dental Insurance
* Paid Time Off, Holidays, and Leave programs.
* Flexible spending accounts
* Basic Life Insurance and Voluntary Life/ADD
* Short Term and Long\-Term Disability

  

UAIC participates in the E\-Verify program to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. For more information about E\-Verify, please visit https://www.e\-verify.gov/.  

  

UAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees. All employment decisions at UAIC are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

new_jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
CSBio is a peptide contract manufacturing founded in 1993\. Our initial products were a complete line of automated synthesizers for manufacturing and process development, with a focus on cGMP production. In 1994, we opened our custom peptide facility and began producing high quality compounds for research organizations and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. In 2004, we opened our peptide production facility in Menlo Park, CA and in 2014, we expanded our production capability through the addition of a new, state of the art building dedicated to cGMP peptide production. In 2017, we passed a FDA inspection and were recommended to be approved for commercial drug substance manufacturing. In 2023, we added additional cGMP clinical production capacity in Milpitas, CA.


We seeking a hands\-on Clinical Operations Manager to lead the planning and execution of longevity and oncology clinical programs. Reporting to the Chief Medical Officer, this person will translate clinical strategy and protocols into practical operating plans, lead study and site start\-up, coordinate sites and vendors, manage timelines and budgets, and ensure consistent execution from feasibility through closeout. The Manager will support the build while preserving the medical, safety, regulatory, and investigator authority of qualified owners.


Job Duties:

* Lead clinical operations across longevity and oncology studies from feasibility and planning through study start\-up, enrollment, conduct, closeout, and archival.
* Translate protocols into detailed operating plans, study timelines, responsibility matrices, site workflows, visit requirements, staffing plans, vendor plans, and readiness criteria.
* Lead site identification, feasibility, qualification, selection, budget and contract coordination, initiation, activation, ongoing management, and closeout.
* Coordinate investigators, clinical sites, CROs, central and specialty laboratories, pharmacies, imaging providers, couriers, technology vendors, and other study partners.
* Own study start\-up and site\-activation tracking, including essential documents, regulatory and ethics submissions, contracts, budgets, training, supplies, systems access, delegation, and activation dependencies.
* Develop and manage clinical operations budgets, forecasts, purchase requests, vendor scopes, invoices, and change orders within approved company controls.
* Establish enrollment, visit, monitoring, data, specimen, investigational\-product, issue, risk, and milestone tracking appropriate to each study.
* Oversee participant\-recruitment readiness, site performance, enrollment progress, protocol adherence, data\-cleaning support, query resolution, and corrective action follow\-through.
* Plan and oversee monitoring activities using internal personnel or CROs, including monitoring plans, visit reports, findings, escalation, and closure of action items.
* Ensure the Trial Master File and site files are complete, current, controlled, and inspection ready in coordination with Regulatory, Quality, and study\-site personnel.
* Identify and escalate operational, safety, medical, regulatory, quality, supply, and timeline risks to the appropriate qualified owner; maintain clear decision and action logs.
* Lead cross\-functional study meetings and provide concise status reporting to the CMO and leadership on milestones, enrollment, budget, risks, decisions, and recovery plans.
* Create and maintain fit\-for\-purpose clinical operations SOPs, work instructions, templates, training, metrics, and vendor oversight practices with Quality and Regulatory review as applicable.
* Hire, train, supervise, and develop clinical operations personnel, including clinical research coordinators and study\-management staff; establish clear responsibilities and backup coverage.
* Support audits, inspections, due diligence, and sponsor or partner reviews by providing complete operational records and timely responses.

  

**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, nursing, pharmacy, public health, clinical research, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 5\+ years of progressive clinical operations experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, a CRO, an academic research center, or a clinical\-site organization.
* 2\+ years of experience leading clinical studies, sites, vendors, projects, or clinical operations personnel.
* Demonstrated experience with study start\-up, site initiation and activation, study conduct, monitoring oversight, enrollment, vendor coordination, and closeout.
* Working knowledge of ICH\-GCP, informed\-consent requirements, protocol compliance, essential documents, safety escalation, privacy, and inspection readiness.
* Experience managing clinical timelines, budgets, contracts, CROs or vendors, risks, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Strong written communication, meeting leadership, documentation, prioritization, and practical problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work on site as required and travel to clinical sites, investigators, and vendors.

  

**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (Kaiser HMO or BlueShield PPO. Employer pays 90% for Employee and 75% for Employee’s family; Dental: Aetna Dental, Delta Dental, Guardian Dental, MetLife Dental. Vision: VSP and Aetna EyeMed)
* 401k 10% 1:1 match
* PTO policy. 10 days PTO
* Companywide paid holiday during: Week of July 4, Thanksgiving (2 days), Week of December 25
* Basic life ($20,000 paid by company) and supplemental life insurance (optional supplemental).
* Disability insurance 50% standard employer paid.
* Carpool, clean air vehicle, and cell phone reimbursement
* Employee rewards and recognition program
* Company organized social events
* Quarterly sponsored team building activities

new_jobs.title: Senior People Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Swift Navigation**  

is hiring. Let us introduce ourselves. Swift is changing the way we navigate and understand the world. Swift’s precise positioning technology platform improves location accuracy from several meters to centimeter\-level and is used by millions of devices across the globe. Swift’s technology is trusted by users across industries, enabling safer driving, improving efficiency for last\-mile delivery and commercial transport operations, increasing accuracy for mobile devices and creating new possibilities for rail, robotics and machine control. That’s what we offer our customers and partners, but it’s the work we do together as a team that is the best part of our days. We collaborate—across the globe—to tackle problems, to pursue our mission and to make a real impact in the world. We are diverse, flexible, supportive and we believe our team is our most important asset and offer a host of benefits and programs to ensure that they know it.

  



Swift Navigation is looking for an outstanding Senior People Operations Manager to own and run the full scope of HR for our global team across 12 countries, from onboarding and employee relations to performance management, payroll, benefits and engagement. As our sole HR professional, the People Operations Manager will play a key role by delivering a consistent, compliant and positive employee experience in every country where we operate, keeping our people data accurate and reliable, and helping managers build a culture where our team can do its best work.

  


**Duties/Responsibilities:**


* Serve as the company’s sole People Operations lead and the first point of contact for employees and managers on all HR matters across 12 countries.
* Own end\-to\-end onboarding, including offer paperwork, pre\-boarding, new hire orientation and 30/60/90\-day check\-ins, in partnership with hiring managers, IT and Finance.
* Advise managers and employees on employee relations matters; conduct investigations, document outcomes and resolve concerns fairly, confidentially and in line with local law.
* Run the performance management cycle, including annual reviews, calibration support and performance improvement plans, and coach managers on giving effective feedback.
* Partner with Finance and our payroll providers to support accurate, on\-time payroll in each country by collecting and validating inputs (new hires, terminations, compensation changes, leave, bonuses) and resolving discrepancies.
* Administer and maintain the HRIS as the single source of truth for employee data; ensure data integrity, manage system updates and integrations, and produce headcount and people reports for leadership.
* Manage the PEO relationship and any Employer of Record (EOR) partners, serving as the primary contact for service issues, renewals, compliance questions and escalations.
* Administer benefits programs, including open enrollment, vendor management, employee questions and periodic benchmarking to keep our offerings competitive in each market.
* Manage offboarding, including exit interviews, coordination of final pay and documentation, and analysis of exit trends to identify retention risks and opportunities.
* Design and lead employee engagement initiatives, such as engagement surveys, recognition programs and virtual and in\-person events that connect a globally distributed team.
* Maintain the employee handbook, country\-specific policies and HR processes; monitor employment law changes in the countries where we operate and keep the company compliant.
* Support compensation reviews, promotions and leave administration in partnership with leadership and Finance.
* Other duties as needed.

  


**Required Skills/Abilities:**


* 6\+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3 years as an HR generalist or manager, ideally as a solo or small\-team HR lead.
* Experience supporting a distributed, multi\-country workforce, including working with PEOs and/or EORs.
* Strong working knowledge of US employment law and familiarity with employment practices in other regions (such as Europe and APAC), plus the ability to research local requirements quickly.
* Hands\-on experience administering an HRIS (BambooHR a plus) and supporting multi\-country payroll.
* Sound judgment in handling sensitive employee relations matters with discretion, empathy and objectivity.
* Self\-directed and highly organized, with the ability to prioritize competing demands and deliver without a larger team to lean on.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build trust with employees at every level, across cultures and time zones.

new_jobs.description:

Tesla's Industrial Products team is looking for a Senior Product Launch Manager to own go\-to\-market execution for Industrial products like the Megapack and its associated products and services. You will drive launches of new hardware, software features, and service offerings from engineering readiness through first\-customer operationalization and post\-launch success.


This is a cross\-functional role. You will coordinate across engineering, sales, sales engineering, service, compliance, finance, and content. You will not own the product roadmap. You will own making each launch sellable, contractable, and deliverable on the date we commit. Success is a product that Sales can quote, Legal can contract, Service can commission, and the first customer can operate — without a scramble.

 **What You'll Do*** Define and execute go\-to\-market plans for new Industrial hardware, software features, and service offerings
* Own the launch operating system: one tracker per launch, named gates, named owners, and weekly risk reviews through commercial cut\-in
* Surface requirements, dependencies, and blockers across hardware, software, services, compliance, finance, sales operations, technical publications, and content — and drive action to dates
* Make products sellable on day one: sales tools, contract and warranty language, partner documentation, and sales training
* Drive first\-customer and first\-country operationalization with Sales, Sales Engineering, and Service
* Hold the organization accountable through commercial cut\-in gates: quoteable, contractable, commissionable
* Feed field and customer launch issues back to product owners until the original success metric is met
* Report launch status to Product leadership with clear risks, owners, and recovery plans
* Improve the launch process so each subsequent hardware, software, and service cutover is faster and cleaner
  

**What You'll Bring*** Degree in Engineering or equivalent experience
* 5–7\+ years launching hardware products and software features in energy, infrastructure, or industrial B2B
* Direct experience making cross\-functional change happen in a global organization
* Comfort interfacing with external customers, EPCs, developers, and senior internal leaders
* Working knowledge of utility\-scale energy storage, grid interconnection, or related power systems
* Proven ability to drive sales\-tool, contract, and documentation cut\-in as part of launch — not after
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. Can hold a room of engineers and a room of sales
* Relentless drive to close gaps. Does not accept almost ready
* Ability to run multiple launches in parallel and pivot without dropping the critical path

Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:


* Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution

* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits

* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program

$136,000 \- $264,000/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits
